title: Dallas Holocaust and Human Rights Museum All Day Ticket
includes: Access to the film "Voices of Courage"
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the Museum’s permanent exhibition, featuring three wings: the Holocaust/Shoah Wing, Human Rights Wing, and Pivot to America Wing. The exhibition includes interactive displays, rare artifacts, survivor testimonies, and historical timelines that connect past and present. Guests can also engage with Dimensions in Testimony, an interactive biography of a Holocaust survivor that allows visitors to ask questions and receive real-time responses. Rotating special exhibitions throughout the year further expand on themes of social justice, civil rights, and human resilience.
